coaching.headline: Paper favored us in four of five lanes and we opened 6-1 across the first two fights — then Fangtooth went over three times, we cashed one won fight to their four, and the majors ledger closed 11-22.
coaching.team: This film is a clinic in one-sided trades. At 10 Murdock won the bodies 2-0 at their Fangtooth pit while they took Fangtooth itself across the map, and the 16.6 won teamfight was traded the same way. Our losses were downhill fights: 12.7 went 0-3 with Mini Prime following at 13.7, and 19.7 and 23.8 both went 0-2 with the same macro note each time — the duo lane was ahead and in lane, not at the fight — with 23.8 also taken two items down, 4 to their 6. They caught six of us out alone; we caught nobody all game. The 28.1 fight went 0-3 and the inner tower, inhibitor and Core fell between 28.2 and 28.7. When we are ahead in four lanes, the leads have to walk: shove and rotate to the fight, or nobody starts one until they do.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Minutes 19.7 to 28.7. Two 0-2 losses at 19.7 and 23.8 — both started while Mr_Meat31 and Goldilocks324 were alive and ahead in the duo lane — bracketed the window where they banked Genesis Core at 22, Fangtooth at 24 and Orb Prime at 26. The 28.1 fight was the receipt: 0-3, and our inner tower, inhibitor and Core were gone within forty seconds.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's Murdock won the carry matchup wire to wire on paper and put up 10 kills, opening on Adele at 2.5 and Rampage at 4.3. The costs came from playing it solo: six deaths against the 3 norm, two of them caught alone (6.7 by Rampage, 20.4 by Legion), and the macro notes name him three times — 12.7, 19.7, 23.8 — as ahead and in lane while fights were lost 0-2 and 0-3. A winning lane is a rotation engine, not a farm to sit in. And Tainted Rounds landed as the fourth item, around minute 31 by the gold model in a 29-minute game, while Rampage healed 32,148 — the anti-heal needed to come slots earlier.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Phase went 3/3/11 with 18 wards against the 13 norm and 15,065 healing, in a support lane the paper read favored all game. The same three macro notes name her alongside Murdock — ahead, alive, and absent from the 0-2 and 0-3 losses at 12.7, 19.7 and 23.8 — and she was caught alone by Rampage at 20.8 in the stretch where the game slid. By the gold model her Tainted Scepter was the last item, around minute 30 in a 29-minute game. The fix for the duo is shared: cash the lane lead into mid-map presence while it still decides fights, and move as a pair rather than getting picked crossing solo.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Adele. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Web Lash root → Crushing Maw armor shred → Hellfire eye → Consume pull-channel
enemyKits.winCondition: root with Web Lash and grind with Hunger-stacked haste
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst on his rooted target
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash — without the root he has no lock-down; interrupt Consume

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Pounce → Rumble slow → Boulder Throw → Behemoth ult to brawl
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Pounce, grow with Behemoth and out-sustain the fight
enemyKits.passive: ramping health regen for jungle sustain
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he front-lines and CCs
enemyKits.playAgainst: anti-heal and kiting beat his sustain brawl; burst him before Behemoth
